meaning.short_meaning: Army, force, front; a name of Durga
meaning.long_meaning: Anika corresponds to the Sanskrit form अनीक. Its core lexical sense is army, force, front; a name of durga. अनीक (anīka) means army, force or front; it is also recorded as a name of Durga. The source gloss 'graceful, beautiful' is not the Sanskrit sense.
